title: C08 Current caching model ('use cache')

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The solution demonstrates 'use cache' at file, function, AND component level (three distinct usages), each compiling and producing observable caching against the pinned Next.js 16 (QA: repo builds; behaviour observable).
cacheTag and cacheLife are applied to cached units using the shared TAG constants from lib/data/tags.ts, and the cacheLife profile choice is explained in NOTES.md.
The solution contrasts per-request cache() with cross-request 'use cache' and demonstrates the everything-dynamic-by-default baseline (an uncached read re-runs per request) in the lab notes.
cache-flow.md contains the committed cache-flow diagram showing what is cached, under which tag/lifetime, and when it is served vs recomputed.

The c08 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers + the cache-flow diagram), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts; data is read via a local _lib helper over lib/data without editing lib/data.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
